Multi-stop route planning with image landmark

To plan a multi-stop route that includes a landmark shown in an image, begin by identifying the landmark using a place search tool capable of interpreting image content or related text queries. Next, geocode the starting location and the final destination to obtain their coordinates. Once the landmark is identified and all locations are geocoded, search for supermarkets situated along the route between the landmark and the final destination, or between any two relevant waypoints. After gathering all necessary waypoints—the starting location, the identified landmark, a selected supermarket, and the final destination—generate at least three different travel routes that include all these stops. Finally, compare the travel times or speeds of these routes to determine which option is the fastest. This workflow ensures that the route is optimized for efficiency while including all required stops.
